defs: def row($coll; $key; $id): .config[$coll][] | select(.[$key] == $id); def source_of($trigger): row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; (row("triggers"; "trigger_id"; $trigger) | .source.event_source_id)); def workspace($binding; $collection; $prompt): . as $d | row("callback_bindings"; "binding_id"; $binding) as $b | $d | row("event_sources"; "event_source_id"; $b.event_source_id) | .source_collection == $collection and ($d.assets[$prompt] | (contains("make worktree BRANCH=") | not) and (contains("Do not run `git commit`") or contains("Do not run git commit")));

jq.name: the pack is typed, static and writes through the write tool package
jq.expr: .scenario.init.tool_package == "write" and (.scenario.expect.prompt_tool_contracts | length) == 14 and (.scenario.expect.result_documents | length) == 17 and (.config.agent_behaviors | length) == 16 and (.config.tasks | length) == 16 and (.config.triggers | length) == 16

jq.name: both fan-outs close: each fan-out trigger reads a run-correlated source and declares its count source
jq.expr: . as $d | ["defend-scan", "defend-verifier", "defend-contract-review"] | all(. as $t | $d | source_of($t) | .correlation_field == "run_id") and ([("DefenseReviewArea","DefenseVerificationAssignment","DefenseRootCauseCluster")] as $want | [$d | source_of("defend-scan"), source_of("defend-verifier"), source_of("defend-contract-review") | .source_collection] == $want) and (["defend-scan", "defend-verifier", "defend-contract-review"] | all(. as $t | $d.scenario.expect.trigger_request_count_sources | has($t)))

jq.name: patch reviews only fire for documents that carry a workspace
jq.expr: ["defend-patch-review", "defend-patch-security-review"] as $ids | . as $d | $ids | all(. as $t | $d | source_of($t) | .filter == "{ _and: [ { workspace_id: { _neq: null } }, { workspace_id: { _ne: \"\" } } ] }")

jq.name: the skip surface writes every patch outcome collection
the patch workspace callback is bound and the worker may not commit
